ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC$, $\angle A=120^\circ$, and $BC=15$ cm. The perpendicular bisector of $AB$ intersects $AB$ at point D and intersects $BC$ at point E; the perpendicular bisector of $AC$ intersects $AC$ at point G, and intersects $BC$ at point F. What is the length of $EF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let us connect $AE$ and $AF$,\\
since the perpendicular bisector of $AB$ intersects $AB$ at point D and $BC$ at point E; the perpendicular bisector of $AC$ intersects $AC$ at point G,\\
it follows that $BE=AE$, $CF=AF$,\\
therefore $\angle EAB=\angle B$, $\angle CAF=\angle C$,\\
since $\angle BAC=120^\circ$ and $AB=AC$,\\
it follows that $\angle B=\angle C=30^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle BAE+\angle CAF=60^\circ$, $\angle AEF=\angle AFE=60^\circ$,\\
thus $\triangle AEF$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
hence $AE=AF=EF$,\\
consequently, $BE=EF=FC$,\\
since $BC=15=BE+EF+FC=3EF$,\\
it follows that $EF=\boxed{5}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle ABC, A is above, B and C are below and BC is the horizontal base; AB and AC form the two legs of the isosceles triangle. Point D is located on AB, and an oblique line passing through D intersects the base BC at E; point G is located on AC, and an oblique line passing through G intersects the base BC at F. The order of the points on the base is B, E, F, C. Reasoning: Connect AE and AF. Because E is on the perpendicular bisector of AB, the distances from E to A and B are equal, that is, AE=BE. Because F is on the perpendicular bisector of AC, the distances from F to A and C are equal, that is, AF=CF. Also because AB=AC and ∠A=120°, the base angles of isosceles triangle ABC are ∠B=∠C=(180°-120°)/2=30°. In triangle ABE, AE=BE, so its base is AB, hence ∠EAB=∠ABE=30°. Similarly, in triangle ACF, AF=CF, and ∠ACF=30°, so ∠CAF=30°. Therefore ∠EAF=∠BAC-∠EAB-∠CAF=120°-30°-30°=60°. Also because B, E, F, C are collinear, ∠AEF and ∠AEB are supplementary; and in triangle ABE, ∠AEB=180°-30°-30°=120°, so ∠AEF=60°. Similarly ∠AFE=60°. Therefore triangle AEF is an equilateral triangle, AE=AF=EF. Combining AE=BE and AF=CF, we can get BE=EF=FC. Thus BC=BE+EF+FC=3EF=15, so EF=5 cm.
